1. Carrier Generation and Recombination [REF: Sect.6.1]
1. 载流子产生与复合 [参考：第 6.1 节]

  • At absolute zero ( T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K} ), all the states in the valence band (VB) of a semiconductor are occupied, while the conduction band (CB) is empty. This corresponds to all the covalent bonds in the semiconductor being intact.
    在绝对零度（ T = 0 K T = 0 K T=0KT=0 \mathrm{~K} ）时，半导体的价带（VB）中所有态都被占据，而导带（CB）为空。这对应于半导体中所有共价键均保持完整。
  • At finite temperatures, some of the electrons in the VB will have sufficient energy to be excited across the bandgap (this is purely statistical), and an electron entering the CB (thereby creating a conduction electron) leaves behind a hole in the VB. This simultaneous creation of an electron-hole pair (EHP) is termed a generation process.
    在有限温度下，价带中的一些电子将具有足够的能量跃迁过带隙（这纯属统计现象），电子进入导带（从而产生导电电子）的同时，在价带中留下一个空穴。这种电子-空穴对（EHP）的同时产生过程称为产生过程。
EHP Generation  电子空穴对生成
  • In equilibrium, there should be some annihilation process that returns the electron from the CB down to an empty state (a hole) in VB.
    在平衡状态下，应该存在某种湮灭过程，将电子从导带返回到价带中的空态（空穴）。
  • When a conduction electron, wandering around the conduction band of the crystal, “meets” a hole, it falls into this low-energy empty state and fills it (thereby reforming the covalen’ '—. quad\quad ’ . ’
    当一个导带中的电子在晶体导带中游走时，“遇到”一个空穴，它会落入这个低能量的空态并填充它（从而重新形成共价键）。
    This process  这个过程
Recombination leading to annihilation of EHP
导致电子空穴对湮灭的复合过程

1.1 The Semiconductor at Thermal Equilibrium
1.1 热平衡下的半导体

  • At thermal equilibrium, the generation rate and recombination rates are equal. This dynamic equilibrium establishes a population of electrons in the CB , and a population of holes in the VB .
    在热平衡状态下，产生率和复合率相等。这种动态平衡建立了导带中的电子群体和价带中的空穴群体。
Schematic of generation and recombination processes
产生和复合过程示意图
  • At higher temperatures, the valence band electrons have more thermal energy, and the generation rate is higher, but so is the recombination rate because there is a larger population of electrons and holes
    在较高温度下，价带电子具有更多的热能，产生率更高，但复合率也更高，因为电子和空穴的数量更多

2. Excess Carrier Generation and Recombination

1. Excess Carrier Generation
1. 过量载流子的产生

  • EHPs can also be created by irradiating the semiconductor with light or some other energetic photon, in a process known as photogeneration.
    电子-空穴对（EHPs）也可以通过用光或其他高能光子照射半导体产生，这一过程称为光生。
  • This can only happen provided the photon energy E p h o t o n E p h o t o n E_(photon)E_{p h o t o n} is greater than the bandgap of the semiconductor,
    这只有在光子能量 E p h o t o n E p h o t o n E_(photon)E_{p h o t o n} 大于半导体的带隙时才会发生，
E photon = h f = h c λ > E g E photon  = h f = h c λ > E g E_("photon ")=hf=(hc)/(lambda) > E_(g)E_{\text {photon }}=h f=\frac{h c}{\lambda}>E_{g}
where  其中
h : Planck constant h = 6.626 × 10 − 34 J . s h  : Planck constant  h = 6.626 × 10 − 34 J . s h" : Planck constant "h=6.626 xx10^(-34)J.sh \text { : Planck constant } h=6.626 \times 10^{-34} \mathrm{~J} . \mathrm{s}
f f ff : frequency of light
f f ff ：光的频率
c: speed of light c = 2.998 × 10 8 ms − 1 c = 2.998 × 10 8 ms − 1 c=2.998 xx10^(8)ms^(-1)c=2.998 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}
c：光速 c = 2.998 × 10 8 ms − 1 c = 2.998 × 10 8 ms − 1 c=2.998 xx10^(8)ms^(-1)c=2.998 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}
λ λ lambda\lambda : wavelength of light
λ λ lambda\lambda ：光的波长
  • Note that if the photon energy is greater than E g E g E_(g)E_{g}, transitions other than those near the band edges E C E C E_(C)E_{C} and E V E V E_(V)E_{V} are possible.
    注意，如果光子能量大于 E g E g E_(g)E_{g} ，则除带边附近的跃迁 E C E C E_(C)E_{C} 和 E V E V E_(V)E_{V} 之外的跃迁也是可能的。

Example  例子

A light source is used to create EHPs in a GaAs sample ( E g = 1.42 eV E g = 1.42 eV E_(g)=1.42eVE_{g}=1.42 \mathrm{eV} ). What is the longest wavelength that can be used?
使用光源在 GaAs 样品中产生电子-空穴对（ E g = 1.42 eV E g = 1.42 eV E_(g)=1.42eVE_{g}=1.42 \mathrm{eV} ）。可以使用的最长波长是多少？
λ < h c E g = ( 6.626 × 10 − 34 J . s ) ⋅ ( 2.998 × 10 8 ms − 1 ) 1.42 eV ⋅ 1.602 × 10 − 19 J / eV = 873 nm λ < h c E g = 6.626 × 10 − 34 J . s ⋅ 2.998 × 10 8 ms − 1 1.42 eV ⋅ 1.602 × 10 − 19 J / eV = 873 nm lambda < (hc)/(E_(g))=((6.626 xx10^(-34)(J).s)*(2.998 xx10^(8)ms^(-1)))/(1.42eV*1.602 xx10^(-19)(J)//eV)=873nm\lambda<\frac{h c}{E_{g}}=\frac{\left(6.626 \times 10^{-34} \mathrm{~J} . \mathrm{s}\right) \cdot\left(2.998 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}\right)}{1.42 \mathrm{eV} \cdot 1.602 \times 10^{-19} \mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{eV}}=873 \mathrm{~nm}
  • The additional electrons and holes generated are called excess electrons and excess holes.
    额外产生的电子和空穴称为多余电子和多余空穴。
  • Note that under such circumstances, the semiconductor is no longer in thermal equilibrium - there is an input of (light) energy into the semiconductor, and the carrier populations are no longer those at thermal equilibrium.
    注意，在这种情况下，半导体不再处于热平衡状态——有光能输入到半导体中，载流子浓度不再是热平衡时的状态。

g n ′ = g p ′ = g ′ g n ′ = g p ′ = g ′ g_(n)^(')=g_(p)^(')=g^(')g_{n}^{\prime}=g_{p}^{\prime}=g^{\prime}

g p ′ g p ′ g_(p)^(')g_{p}^{\prime} : excess hole generation rate (#/cm 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3}.s)
g p ′ g p ′ g_(p)^(')g_{p}^{\prime} ：多余空穴产生速率（#/cm 3 3 ^(3){ }^{3} ·秒）
  • When excess electrons and excess holes are created, the concentration of electrons and holes are now above their values at thermal equilibrium and we have,
    当多余电子和多余空穴被产生时，电子和空穴的浓度现在高于它们在热平衡时的值，我们有，
n = n 0 + δ n p = p 0 + δ p n = n 0 + δ n p = p 0 + δ p {:[n=n_(0)+delta n],[p=p_(0)+delta p]:}\begin{aligned} & n=n_{0}+\delta n \\ & p=p_{0}+\delta p \end{aligned}

δ n δ n delta n quad\delta n \quad : excess electron concentration
δ n δ n delta n quad\delta n \quad ：多余电子浓度
δ p δ p delta p\delta p : excess hole concentration
δ p δ p delta p\delta p ：多余空穴浓度

    很明显，在非平衡条件下， p n ≠ p 0 n 0 = n 2 i p n ≠ p 0 n 0 = n 2 i pn!=p_(0)n_(0)=n^(2)_(i)p n \neq p_{0} n_{0}=n^{2}{ }_{i}

1.2.2 Excess Carrier Recombination
1.2.2 过量载流子复合

  • We now want to consider how the excess carrier population changes after excess carriers have been introduced into the semiconductor.
    现在我们要考虑在半导体中引入过量载流子后，过量载流子数量如何变化。
  • Let us assume that an excess electron-hole pair population is created at time t = 0 t = 0 t=0t=0, for example, by a short flash of light.
    假设在时间 t = 0 t = 0 t=0t=0 产生了过量的电子-空穴对，例如通过一次短暂的光闪。
  • After the excess carriers have been generated, the generation rate is still the same as it was before the flash of light (since the generation by thermal generation has always been there)
    在多余载流子被产生之后，产生速率仍然和闪光灯之前一样（因为热产生一直存在）
  • But the recombination rate has
    但是复合速率已经
    increased since there are now excess electrons and excess holes on top of the thermal-equilibrium population.
    增加了，因为现在除了热平衡载流子外，还有多余的电子和多余的空穴。

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors Carrier Generation and Recombination
半导体中的非平衡多余载流子 载流子产生与复合

  • We are often interested in the minority carrier concentration in a doped semiconductor.
    我们常常关注掺杂半导体中的少数载流子浓度。
  • Consider a situation where:
    考虑以下情况：
  1. Semiconductor is p-type, with a thermal-equilibrium hole conc. p p 0 ≫ n p 0 p p 0 ≫ n p 0 p_(p0)≫n_(p0)p_{p 0} \gg n_{p 0}
    半导体为 p 型，热平衡空穴浓度为 p p 0 ≫ n p 0 p p 0 ≫ n p 0 p_(p0)≫n_(p0)p_{p 0} \gg n_{p 0}
    2.Number of excess carriers is much less than the thermal equilibrium majority carrier concentration, i.e., δ n p = δ p p ≪ p p 0 δ n p = δ p p ≪ p p 0 deltan_(p)=deltap_(p)≪p_(p0)\delta n_{p}=\delta p_{p} \ll p_{p 0} (low-level injection).
    2. 过量载流子数远小于热平衡多数载流子浓度，即 δ n p = δ p p ≪ p p 0 δ n p = δ p p ≪ p p 0 deltan_(p)=deltap_(p)≪p_(p0)\delta n_{p}=\delta p_{p} \ll p_{p 0} （低注入水平）。
  • It can be shown that the excess minority carrier concentration decays exponentially:
    可以证明，过量少数载流子浓度呈指数衰减：
δ n ( t ) = δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − α r p p 0 t = δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ n δ n ( t ) = δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − α r p p 0 t = δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ n delta n(t)=deltan_(p)(0)*e^(-alpha_(r)p_(p0)t)=deltan_(p)(0)*e^(-t//tau_(n))\delta n(t)=\delta n_{p}(0) \cdot e^{-\alpha_{r} p_{p 0} t}=\delta n_{p}(0) \cdot e^{-t / \tau_{n}}
where  其中
τ n = 1 α r p p 0 τ n = 1 α r p p 0 tau_(n)=(1)/(alpha_(r)p_(p0))\tau_{n}=\frac{1}{\alpha_{r} p_{p 0}}

is referred to as the minority carrier lifetime. It represent the average time an excess minority carrier will exist before it recombines with a majority carrier.
称为少数载流子寿命。它表示一个多余的少数载流子在与多数载流子复合之前存在的平均时间。
An analogy …a catching game
一个类比……一个接球游戏
Dependence of minority carrier lifetime on majority carrier conc.
少数载流子寿命对多数载流子浓度的依赖性
  • A large room has 1000 boys randomly distributed (majority carriers).
    一个大房间里随机分布着 1000 个男孩（多数载流子）。
  • 10 girls & 10 boys enter the room (excess carriers, low-level injection).
    10 个女孩和 10 个男孩进入房间（多余载流子，低注入水平）。
  • It takes 10 seconds for a girl to catch a boy (recombination).
    一个女孩抓到一个男孩（复合）需要 10 秒钟。
  • How long would it take if the room had 2000 boys to begin with?
    如果房间里一开始有 2000 个男孩，需要多长时间？
Deviation from low-level injection.
偏离低注入水平。
  • A large room has 1000 boys randomly distributed (majority carriers).
    一个大房间里随机分布着 1000 个男孩（多数载流子）。
  • 500 girls & 500 boys enter the room (excess carriers, high-level injection).
    500 个女孩和 500 个男孩进入房间（过量载流子，高注入水平）。
  • How long would it take a girl to catch a boy? (recombination).
    一个女孩要多久才能抓到一个男孩？（复合）。

  • Since electrons and holes annihilate each other upon recombination, both excess carriers disappear at the same rate, i.e., δ p ( t ) = δ n ( t ) δ p ( t ) = δ n ( t ) delta p(t)=delta n(t)\delta p(t)=\delta n(t)
    由于电子和空穴在复合时相互湮灭，两个过量载流子以相同的速率消失，即 δ p ( t ) = δ n ( t ) δ p ( t ) = δ n ( t ) delta p(t)=delta n(t)\delta p(t)=\delta n(t)
  • Hence the equation describing the decay of excess minority carriers also describes the decay of excess majority carriers**:
    因此，描述多余少数载流子衰减的方程也描述了多余多数载流子的衰减：
δ n p ( t ) = δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ n = δ p p ( t ) δ n p ( t ) = δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ n = δ p p ( t ) deltan_(p)(t)=deltan_(p)(0)*e^(-t//tau_(n))=deltap_(p)(t)\delta n_{p}(t)=\delta n_{p}(0) \cdot e^{-t / \tau_{n}}=\delta p_{p}(t)
  • The excess carrier recombination rate can be written as,
    多余载流子的复合速率可以写成，
R n ′ = d ( δ δ p ( t ) ) d t = − d d t [ δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ n ] = δ n p ( t ) τ n R n ′ = d δ δ p ( t ) d t = − d d t δ n p ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ n = δ n p ( t ) τ n R_(n)^(')=(d(deltadelta_(p)(t)))/(dt)=-(d)/(dt)[deltan_(p)(0)*e^(-t//tau_(n))]=(deltan_(p)(t))/(tau_(n))R_{n}^{\prime}=\frac{d\left(\delta \delta_{p}(t)\right)}{d t}=-\frac{d}{d t}\left[\delta n_{p}(0) \cdot e^{-t / \tau_{n}}\right]=\frac{\delta n_{p}(t)}{\tau_{n}}
and since δ p p ( t ) = δ n p ( t ) δ p p ( t ) = δ n p ( t ) deltap_(p)(t)=deltan_(p)(t)\delta p_{p}(t)=\delta n_{p}(t)  并且由于 δ p p ( t ) = δ n p ( t ) δ p p ( t ) = δ n p ( t ) deltap_(p)(t)=deltan_(p)(t)\delta p_{p}(t)=\delta n_{p}(t)
R p ′ = R n ′ = δ n p ( t ) τ n R p ′ = R n ′ = δ n p ( t ) τ n R_(p)^(')=R_(n)^(')=(deltan_(p)(t))/(tau_(n))R_{p}^{\prime}=R_{n}^{\prime}=\frac{\delta n_{p}(t)}{\tau_{n}}

δ p n ( t ) = δ p n ( 0 ) ⋅ e − α r n n 0 t = δ p n ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ p δ p n ( t ) = δ p n ( 0 ) ⋅ e − α r n n 0 t = δ p n ( 0 ) ⋅ e − t / τ p deltap_(n)(t)=deltap_(n)(0)*e^(-alpha_(r)n_(n0)t)=deltap_(n)(0)*e^(-t//tau_(p))\delta p_{n}(t)=\delta p_{n}(0) \cdot e^{-\alpha_{r} n_{n 0} t}=\delta p_{n}(0) \cdot e^{-t / \tau_{p}}

1.3 Low-level injection  1.3 低注入水平

  • Low-level injection means that the excess carrier concentration is small (usually taken as less than 10%) compared to the majority carrier concentration.
    低注入水平意味着多余载流子浓度相对于多数载流子浓度较小（通常认为小于 10%）。
  • Conversely, high-level injection occurs when the excess carrier concentration becomes comparable to or greater than the thermal equilibrium majority carrier concentrations, and hence results in a significant increase in the number of majority carriers.
    相反，高注入水平发生在过量载流子浓度变得与热平衡多数载流子浓度相当或更高时，因此导致多数载流子数量显著增加。
  • For low-level injection, for an n-type semiconductor with an thermal equilibrium majority carrier (electron) concentration of n n 0 n n 0 n_(n0)n_{n 0} (and thermal equilibrium minority carrier concentration of p n 0 p n 0 p_(n0)p_{n 0} ):
    对于低注入水平，对于一个 n 型半导体，其热平衡多数载流子（电子）浓度为 n n 0 n n 0 n_(n0)n_{n 0} （热平衡少数载流子浓度为 p n 0 p n 0 p_(n0)p_{n 0} ）：
δ n n , δ p n < 0.1 × n n 0 δ n n , δ p n < 0.1 × n n 0 deltan_(n),deltap_(n) < 0.1 xxn_(n0)\delta n_{n}, \delta p_{n}<0.1 \times n_{n 0}
  • Likewise, for a p-type semiconductor:
    同样，对于 p 型半导体：
δ n p , δ p p < 0.1 × p p 0 δ n p , δ p p < 0.1 × p p 0 deltan_(p),deltap_(p) < 0.1 xxp_(p0)\delta n_{p}, \delta p_{p}<0.1 \times p_{p 0}
where p p 0 p p 0 p_(p0)p_{p 0} is the thermal equilibrium majority carrier concentration in the p-type semiconductor.
其中 p p 0 p p 0 p_(p0)p_{p 0} 是 p 型半导体中热平衡多数载流子浓度。

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors Carrier Generation and Recombination
半导体中的非平衡多余载流子 载流子产生与复合

  • Note that under low-level injection, it is possible (and most likely) that the excess carrier concentration will greatly exceed the thermal equilibrium minority carrier concentration, i.e., for an n-type semiconductor, δ p n ≫ p n 0 δ p n ≫ p n 0 deltap_(n)≫p_(n0)\delta p_{n} \gg p_{n 0} and thus,
    注意，在低注入水平下，多余载流子浓度很可能远远超过热平衡少数载流子浓度，即对于 n 型半导体， δ p n ≫ p n 0 δ p n ≫ p n 0 deltap_(n)≫p_(n0)\delta p_{n} \gg p_{n 0} ，因此，
p n = δ p n + p n 0 ≫ p n 0 , while n n = δ n n + n n 0 ≅ n n 0 p n = δ p n + p n 0 ≫ p n 0 ,  while  n n = δ n n + n n 0 ≅ n n 0 {:[p_(n)=deltap_(n)+p_(n0)≫p_(n0)","" while "],[n_(n)=deltan_(n)+n_(n0)~=n_(n0)]:}\begin{aligned} & p_{n}=\delta p_{n}+p_{n 0} \gg p_{n 0}, \text { while } \\ & n_{n}=\delta n_{n}+n_{n 0} \cong n_{n 0} \end{aligned}
  • In other words, the minority carrier concentration can become much greater than the equilibrium minority carrier concentration, while the majority carrier concentration has not changed much.
    换句话说，少数载流子浓度可以远大于平衡少数载流子浓度，而多数载流子浓度几乎没有变化。
  • For a p-type semiconductor:
    对于 p 型半导体：
n p = δ n p + n p 0 ≫ n p 0 , while p p = δ p p + p p 0 ≅ p p 0 n p = δ n p + n p 0 ≫ n p 0 ,  while  p p = δ p p + p p 0 ≅ p p 0 {:[n_(p)=deltan_(p)+n_(p0)≫n_(p0)","" while "],[p_(p)=deltap_(p)+p_(p0)~=p_(p0)]:}\begin{aligned} & n_{p}=\delta n_{p}+n_{p 0} \gg n_{p 0}, \text { while } \\ & p_{p}=\delta p_{p}+p_{p 0} \cong p_{p 0} \end{aligned}

Example  例子

A piece of p-type silicon has an equilibrium majority carrier (hole) concentration of p p 0 = 2 × 10 15 cm − 3 p p 0 = 2 × 10 15 cm − 3 p_(p0)=2xx10^(15)cm^(-3)p_{p 0}=2 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}
一块 p 型硅的平衡多数载流子（空穴）浓度为 p p 0 = 2 × 10 15 cm − 3 p p 0 = 2 × 10 15 cm − 3 p_(p0)=2xx10^(15)cm^(-3)p_{p 0}=2 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}
If n i = 1.45 × 10 10 cm − 3 n i = 1.45 × 10 10 cm − 3 n_(i)=1.45 xx10^(10)cm^(-3)n_{i}=1.45 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}, the equilibrium minority (electron) carrier concentration is
如果 n i = 1.45 × 10 10 cm − 3 n i = 1.45 × 10 10 cm − 3 n_(i)=1.45 xx10^(10)cm^(-3)n_{i}=1.45 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} ，平衡少数载流子（电子）浓度为
n p 0 = n i 2 p p 0 = ( 1.45 × 10 10 ) 2 2 × 10 15 = 1.05 × 10 5 cm − 3 n p 0 = n i 2 p p 0 = 1.45 × 10 10 2 2 × 10 15 = 1.05 × 10 5 cm − 3 n_(p0)=(n_(i)^(2))/(p_(p0))=((1.45 xx10^(10))^(2))/(2xx10^(15))=1.05 xx10^(5)cm^(-3)n_{p 0}=\frac{n_{i}^{2}}{p_{p 0}}=\frac{\left(1.45 \times 10^{10}\right)^{2}}{2 \times 10^{15}}=1.05 \times 10^{5} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}
If we create excess EHPs in the sample such that the majority carrier concentration increases by 5 % 5 % 5%5 \%, i.e.,
如果我们在样品中产生过量的电子空穴对，使得多数载流子浓度增加了 5 % 5 % 5%5 \% ，即，
δ n = δ p = 0.05 × p p 0 = 10 14 cm − 3 δ n = δ p = 0.05 × p p 0 = 10 14 cm − 3 delta n=delta p=0.05 xxp_(p0)=10^(14)cm^(-3)\delta n=\delta p=0.05 \times p_{p 0}=10^{14} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}
then the majority (hole) and minority (electron) carrier concentrations will be
那么多数（空穴）和少数（电子）载流子浓度将会是
p p = δ p p + p p 0 = 10 14 + 2 × 10 15 = 2.1 × 10 15 cm − 3 n p = δ n p + n p 0 = 10 14 + 1.05 × 10 5 = 10 14 cm − 3 p p = δ p p + p p 0 = 10 14 + 2 × 10 15 = 2.1 × 10 15 cm − 3 n p = δ n p + n p 0 = 10 14 + 1.05 × 10 5 = 10 14 cm − 3 {:[p_(p)=deltap_(p)+p_(p0)=10^(14)+2xx10^(15)=2.1 xx10^(15)cm^(-3)],[n_(p)=deltan_(p)+n_(p0)=10^(14)+1.05 xx10^(5)=10^(14)cm^(-3)]:}\begin{aligned} & p_{p}=\delta p_{p}+p_{p 0}=10^{14}+2 \times 10^{15}=2.1 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} \\ & n_{p}=\delta n_{p}+n_{p 0}=10^{14}+1.05 \times 10^{5}=10^{14} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} \end{aligned}
  • While the majority carrier concentration has increased by 5 % 5 % 5%5 \%, the minority carrier concentration has increased by 9 orders of magnitude (or 100,000,000,000%!).
    虽然多数载流子浓度增加了 5 % 5 % 5%5 \% ，但少数载流子浓度增加了 9 个数量级（或 100,000,000,000%！）。
  • Note that the minority carrier concentration is dominated by the excess minority carriers, i.e., n p ≅ δ n p n p ≅ δ n p n_(p)~=deltan_(p)n_{p} \cong \delta n_{p}
    注意，少数载流子浓度主要由过量少数载流子主导，即 n p ≅ δ n p n p ≅ δ n p n_(p)~=deltan_(p)n_{p} \cong \delta n_{p}

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors Continuity Equation
半导体中非平衡多余载流子的连续性方程

2. Continuity Equation  2. 连续性方程

  • The ideas on diffusion, drift, generation and recombination can be combined into a single equation, the continuity equation.
    关于扩散、漂移、产生和复合的概念可以结合成一个方程，即连续性方程。
  • The equation expresses the idea that the difference between the numbers of carriers entering a region and leaving it is equal to the change in the number of carriers inside the region.
    该方程表达了进入某区域的载流子数量与离开该区域的载流子数量之差等于该区域内载流子数量的变化。
  • Consider an elemental volume of length d x d x dxd x and area A A AA. Holes are entering the volume through surface S 1 S 1 S_(1)S_{1} and leaving through surface S 2 S 2 S_(2)S_{2}.
    考虑一个长度为 d x d x dxd x 、面积为 A A AA 的微元体积。空穴通过表面 S 1 S 1 S_(1)S_{1} 进入该体积，通过表面 S 2 S 2 S_(2)S_{2} 离开。
  • The hole concentration within volume A . d x A . d x A.dxA . d x is changed by:
    体积 A . d x A . d x A.dxA . d x 内的空穴浓度变化为：
  1. Difference between holes flowing into and out of the volume
    流入和流出该体积的空穴差异
  2. Generation of holes within the volume at rate g p ( cm − 3 . s − 1 ) g p cm − 3 . s − 1 g_(p)(cm^(-3).s^(-1))g_{p}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3} . \mathrm{s}^{-1}\right)
    体积内以速率 g p ( cm − 3 . s − 1 ) g p cm − 3 . s − 1 g_(p)(cm^(-3).s^(-1))g_{p}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3} . \mathrm{s}^{-1}\right) 产生的空穴
  3. Recombination of holes within the volume at rate R p ( cm − 3 ⋅ s − 1 ) R p cm − 3 ⋅ s − 1 R_(p)(cm^(-3)*s^(-1))R_{p}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{-1}\right)
    体积内以速率 R p ( cm − 3 ⋅ s − 1 ) R p cm − 3 ⋅ s − 1 R_(p)(cm^(-3)*s^(-1))R_{p}\left(\mathrm{~cm}^{-3} \cdot \mathrm{~s}^{-1}\right) 复合的空穴
  • The rate of increase of hole concentration within the elemental volume is thus
    元素体积内空穴浓度增加的速率因此为
∂ p ∂ t | x → x + δ x = 1 A ⋅ δ x I p ( x ) − I p ( x + δ x ) e + g p − R p = 1 e A ⋅ δ x ( I p ( x ) − { I p ( x ) + ∂ I p ∂ x δ x } ) + g p − R p = 1 e A ( − ∂ I p ∂ x ) + g p − R p ∂ p ( x , t ) ∂ t = − 1 e ( ∂ J p ∂ x ) + g p − R p ∂ p ∂ t x → x + δ x = 1 A ⋅ δ x I p ( x ) − I p ( x + δ x ) e + g p − R p = 1 e A ⋅ δ x I p ( x ) − I p ( x ) + ∂ I p ∂ x δ x + g p − R p = 1 e A − ∂ I p ∂ x + g p − R p ∂ p ( x , t ) ∂ t = − 1 e ∂ J p ∂ x + g p − R p {:[(del p)/(del t)|_(x rarr x+delta x)=(1)/(A*delta x)(I_(p)(x)-I_(p)(x+delta x))/(e)+g_(p)-R_(p)],[=(1)/(eA*delta x)(I_(p)(x)-{I_(p)(x)+(delI_(p))/(del x)delta x})+g_(p)-R_(p)],[=(1)/(eA)(-(delI_(p))/(del x))+g_(p)-R_(p)],[(del p(x,t))/(del t)=-(1)/(e)((delJ_(p))/(del x))+g_(p)-R_(p)]:}\begin{aligned} \left.\frac{\partial p}{\partial t}\right|_{x \rightarrow x+\delta x} & =\frac{1}{A \cdot \delta x} \frac{I_{p}(x)-I_{p}(x+\delta x)}{e}+g_{p}-R_{p} \\ & =\frac{1}{e A \cdot \delta x}\left(I_{p}(x)-\left\{I_{p}(x)+\frac{\partial I_{p}}{\partial x} \delta x\right\}\right)+g_{p}-R_{p} \\ & =\frac{1}{e A}\left(-\frac{\partial I_{p}}{\partial x}\right)+g_{p}-R_{p} \\ \frac{\partial p(x, t)}{\partial t}= & -\frac{1}{e}\left(\frac{\partial J_{p}}{\partial x}\right)+g_{p}-R_{p} \end{aligned}
where J p = I p / A J p = I p / A J_(p)=I_(p)//AJ_{p}=I_{p} / A is the hole currentdensity.
其中 J p = I p / A J p = I p / A J_(p)=I_(p)//AJ_{p}=I_{p} / A 是空穴电流密度。
  • This is the continuity equation for holes.
    这是空穴的连续性方程。

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors -
半导体中的非平衡多余载流子 -

Continuity Equation  连续性方程
  • We can derive a similar continuity equation for electrons, bearing in mind the opposite direction of current flow:
    我们可以推导出类似的电子连续性方程，注意电流方向相反：
∂ n ∂ t | x → x + δ x = 1 A ⋅ δ x I n ( x + δ x ) − I n ( x ) e + g n − R n = 1 e A ⋅ δ x ( { I n ( x ) + ∂ I n ∂ x δ x } − I n ( x ) ) + g n − R n = 1 e A ( ∂ I n ∂ x ) + g n − R n ∂ n ∂ t x → x + δ x = 1 A ⋅ δ x I n ( x + δ x ) − I n ( x ) e + g n − R n = 1 e A ⋅ δ x I n ( x ) + ∂ I n ∂ x δ x − I n ( x ) + g n − R n = 1 e A ∂ I n ∂ x + g n − R n {:[(del n)/(del t)|_(x rarr x+delta x)=(1)/(A*delta x)(I_(n)(x+delta x)-I_(n)(x))/(e)+g_(n)-R_(n)],[=(1)/(eA*delta x)({I_(n)(x)+(delI_(n))/(del x)delta x}-I_(n)(x))+g_(n)-R_(n)],[=(1)/(eA)((delI_(n))/(del x))+g_(n)-R_(n)]:}\begin{aligned} \left.\frac{\partial n}{\partial t}\right|_{x \rightarrow x+\delta x} & =\frac{1}{A \cdot \delta x} \frac{I_{n}(x+\delta x)-I_{n}(x)}{e}+g_{n}-R_{n} \\ & =\frac{1}{e A \cdot \delta x}\left(\left\{I_{n}(x)+\frac{\partial I_{n}}{\partial x} \delta x\right\}-I_{n}(x)\right)+g_{n}-R_{n} \\ & =\frac{1}{e A}\left(\frac{\partial I_{n}}{\partial x}\right)+g_{n}-R_{n} \end{aligned}
∂ n ( x , t ) ∂ t = + 1 e ( ∂ J n ∂ x ) + g n − R n ∂ n ( x , t ) ∂ t = + 1 e ∂ J n ∂ x + g n − R n (del n(x,t))/(del t)=+(1)/(e)((delJ_(n))/(del x))+g_(n)-R_(n)\frac{\partial n(x, t)}{\partial t}=+\frac{1}{e}\left(\frac{\partial J_{n}}{\partial x}\right)+g_{n}-R_{n}
where J n = I n / A J n = I n / A J_(n)=I_(n)//AJ_{n}=I_{n} / A is the electron current density.
其中 J n = I n / A J n = I n / A J_(n)=I_(n)//AJ_{n}=I_{n} / A 是电子电流密度。
  • Note the difference in the sign for the derivative of the current density is due to the difference in charge between electrons and holes
    注意电流密度导数符号的差异是由于电子和空穴电荷的不同造成的。

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors Continuity Equation
半导体中非平衡多余载流子的连续性方程

2.1 Continuity Equations for Minority Carriers
2.1 少数载流子的连续性方程

  • We are often interested in the minority carrier concentration in a semiconductor.
    我们通常关注半导体中少数载流子的浓度。
  • Under low-level injection, the majority carrier concentration does not change much from that at thermal equilibrium.
    在低注入水平下，多数载流子的浓度与热平衡时相比变化不大。
  • In the case of an n-type semiconductor, where holes are the minority carriers, the generation and recombination terms are:
    在 n 型半导体中，空穴为少数载流子，产生和复合项为：
g p − R p = ( G p 0 + g p ′ ) − ( R p 0 + R p ′ ) g p − R p = G p 0 + g p ′ − R p 0 + R p ′ g_(p)-R_(p)=(G_(p0)+g_(p)^('))-(R_(p0)+R_(p)^('))g_{p}-R_{p}=\left(G_{p 0}+g_{p}^{\prime}\right)-\left(R_{p 0}+R_{p}^{\prime}\right)
where  其中
G p 0 G p 0 G_(p0)G_{p 0} : hole generation rate at thermal equilibrium
G p 0 G p 0 G_(p0)G_{p 0} ：热平衡时的空穴产生率
R p 0 R p 0 R_(p0)R_{p 0} : hole recombination rate at thermal equilibrium
R p 0 R p 0 R_(p0)R_{p 0} ：热平衡时的空穴复合率
g p ′ g p ′ g_(p)^(')quadg_{p}^{\prime} \quad : excess hole generation rate
g p ′ g p ′ g_(p)^(')quadg_{p}^{\prime} \quad ：多余空穴产生率
R p ′ R p ′ R_(p)^(')quadR_{p}^{\prime} \quad : excess hole recombination rate
R p ′ R p ′ R_(p)^(')quadR_{p}^{\prime} \quad ：多余空穴复合率
  • At thermal equilibrium, the generation and recombination rates are equal,
    在热平衡状态下，产生率和复合率相等，
G p 0 = R p 0 G p 0 = R p 0 G_(p0)=R_(p0)G_{p 0}=R_{p 0}
  • Under low-level injection, the excess hole recombination rate is:
    在低注入条件下，多余空穴复合率为：
R p ′ = δ p n τ p R p ′ = δ p n τ p R_(p)^(')=(deltap_(n))/(tau_(p))R_{p}^{\prime}=\frac{\delta p_{n}}{\tau_{p}}
and hence:  因此：
g p − R p = g p ′ − δ p τ p g p − R p = g p ′ − δ p τ p g_(p)-R_(p)=g_(p)^(')-(delta p)/(tau_(p))g_{p}-R_{p}=g_{p}^{\prime}-\frac{\delta p}{\tau_{p}}
  • Thus, under low-level injection conditions, the continuity equation for holes (minority carriers) in the n-type semiconductor is
    因此，在低注入条件下，n 型半导体中空穴（少数载流子）的连续性方程为
  • The equation describes the rate at which the hole concentration is changing at a particular location ( x x xx ). Note the use of partial derivatives as the concentration depends on both temporal and spatial dimensions.
    该方程描述了在特定位置（ x x xx ）空穴浓度变化的速率。注意使用偏导数，因为浓度同时依赖于时间和空间维度。

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors Continuity Equation
半导体中非平衡多余载流子连续性方程

  • Likewise, for a p-type semiconductor where the electrons are minority carriers, under low-level injection conditions, we have the continuity equation for minority carriers (electrons):
    同样，对于 p 型半导体，其中电子是少数载流子，在低注入条件下，我们有少数载流子（电子）的连续性方程：
∂ n p ( x , t ) ∂ t = 1 ∂ J n e ∂ x + g n ′ − δ n p τ n ∂ n p ( x , t ) ∂ t = 1 ∂ J n e ∂ x + g n ′ − δ n p τ n (deln_(p)(x,t))/(del t)=(1delJ_(n))/(e del x)+g_(n)^(')-(deltan_(p))/(tau_(n))\frac{\partial n_{p}(x, t)}{\partial t}=\frac{1 \partial J_{n}}{e \partial x}+g_{n}^{\prime}-\frac{\delta n_{p}}{\tau_{n}}
  • Note that the current densities, J n J n J_(n)J_{n} and J p J p J_(p)J_{p}, in the continuity equations comprise the usual drift and diffusion components:
    注意，连续性方程中的电流密度 J n J n J_(n)J_{n} 和 J p J p J_(p)J_{p} 包含了通常的漂移和扩散分量：
J p = e p μ p E − e D p ∂ p ∂ x J n = e n μ n E + e D n ∂ n ∂ x J p = e p μ p E − e D p ∂ p ∂ x J n = e n μ n E + e D n ∂ n ∂ x {:[J_(p)=epmu_(p)E-eD_(p)(del p)/(del x)],[J_(n)=enmu_(n)E+eD_(n)(del n)/(del x)]:}\begin{aligned} & J_{p}=e p \mu_{p} \mathrm{E}-e D_{p} \frac{\partial p}{\partial x} \\ & J_{n}=e n \mu_{n} \mathrm{E}+e D_{n} \frac{\partial n}{\partial x} \end{aligned}

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors -
半导体中的非平衡多余载流子 -

Continuity Equation  连续性方程

2.2 Current Carried by Diffusion Only
2.2 仅由扩散携带的电流

  • Consider a semi-infinite n-type semiconductor bar that has excess holes injected continuously at the left hand boundary:
    考虑一个半无限长的 n 型半导体棒，在其左端边界持续注入过量空穴：
  • The excess holes may be expected to diffuse from the left-hand boundary where their concentration is high, into the bulk of the semiconductor.
    过量空穴预计会从左端边界（其浓度较高处）扩散到半导体的体内。
  • At the same time, since they have a finite lifetime, they will also recombine with an average minority carrier lifetime of τ p τ p tau_(p)\tau_{p}.
    同时，由于它们具有有限的寿命，它们还将以平均少数载流子寿命为 τ p τ p tau_(p)\tau_{p} 的时间尺度复合。

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors -
半导体中的非平衡多余载流子 -

Continuity Equation  连续性方程
  • Hence the excess holes diffuse to the right, and disappear into the bulk.
    因此，多余的空穴向右扩散，并消失在体内。
  • The excess hole concentration may be expected to decay away from the left-hand boundary.
    多余空穴浓度预计会从左侧边界开始衰减。
  • What is the profile of the hole concentration as a function of distance ( x x xx ) at steady state?
    在稳态下，空穴浓度随距离（ x x xx ）的分布是什么样的？
  • We will consider a special case for the continuity equation where drift currents are negligible (where the electric field is zero or small, and the sample is uniformly doped*). Assuming an n-type sample (minority carriers are holes), then:
    我们将考虑连续性方程的一个特殊情况，其中漂移电流可以忽略不计（电场为零或很小，且样品均匀掺杂*）。假设为 n 型样品（少数载流子为空穴），那么：
J p = J p , diff = − e D p d p n d x J p = J p ,  diff  = − e D p d p n d x J_(p)=J_(p," diff ")=-eD_(p)(dp_(n))/(dx)J_{p}=J_{p, \text { diff }}=-e D_{p} \frac{d p_{n}}{d x}
  • The continuity equation for holes as minority carriers is thus:
    少数载流子空穴的连续性方程为：
∂ p n ∂ t = − 1 e ∂ J ∂ x + g p ′ − δ p n τ p = − 1 ∂ e ∂ x ◻ ◻ ◻ ◻ ∂ p n ∂ x ◻ + g p ′ − δ p n τ p ∴ ∂ p / h ∂ t = D p ∂ 2 p n ∂ x 2 + g p ′ / − δ p n τ p ∂ p n ∂ t = − 1 e ∂ J ∂ x + g p ′ − δ p n τ p = − 1 ∂ e ∂ x ◻ ◻ ◻ ◻ ∂ p n ∂ x ◻ + g p ′ − δ p n τ p ∴ ∂ p / h ∂ t = D p ∂ 2 p n ∂ x 2 + g p ′ / − δ p n τ p {:[(delp_(n))/(del t)=-(1)/(e)(del J)/(del x)+g_(p)^(')-(deltap_(n))/(tau_(p))=-(1del)/(e del x◻)◻◻^(◻)(delp_(n))/(del x)◻+g_(p)^(')-(deltap_(n))/(tau_(p))],[:.(del p//h)/(del t)=D_(p)(del^(2)p_(n))/(delx^(2))+g_(p)^(')//-(deltap_(n))/(tau_(p))]:}\begin{aligned} & \frac{\partial p_{n}}{\partial t}=-\frac{1}{e} \frac{\partial J}{\partial x}+g_{p}^{\prime}-\frac{\delta p_{n}}{\tau_{p}}=-\frac{1 \partial}{e \partial x \square} \square \square^{\square} \frac{\partial p_{n}}{\partial x} \square+g_{p}^{\prime}-\frac{\delta p_{n}}{\tau_{p}} \\ & \therefore \frac{\partial p / h}{\partial t}=D_{p} \frac{\partial^{2} p_{n}}{\partial x^{2}}+g_{p}^{\prime} /-\frac{\delta p_{n}}{\tau_{p}} \end{aligned}
  • We now make 2 simplifications:
    现在我们做两个简化：
    (a)No external source of hole generation (inside the sample): g p ′ = 0 g p ′ = 0 g_(p)^(')=0g_{p}^{\prime}=0
    (a) 样品内部无外部空穴生成源： g p ′ = 0 g p ′ = 0 g_(p)^(')=0g_{p}^{\prime}=0
    (b)Steady-state conditions only, i.e., ∂ p n / ∂ t = 0 ∂ p n / ∂ t = 0 delp_(n)//del t=0\partial p_{n} / \partial t=0
    (b) 仅稳态条件，即 ∂ p n / ∂ t = 0 ∂ p n / ∂ t = 0 delp_(n)//del t=0\partial p_{n} / \partial t=0
  • Non-uniform doping can give rise to large electric fields, and hence large drift currents
    非均匀掺杂会产生较大的电场，从而产生较大的漂移电流
  • The continuity equation reduces to:
    连续性方程简化为：
0 = D p ∂ 2 p n ∂ x 2 − δ p n τ p ⇒ d 2 p n d x 2 D δ p n τ p p 0 = D p ∂ 2 p n ∂ x 2 − δ p n τ p ⇒ d 2 p n d x 2 D δ p n τ p p 0=D_(p)(del^(2)p_(n))/(delx^(2))-(deltap_(n))/(tau_(p))=>(d^(2)p_(n))/(dx^(2))D(deltap_(n))/(tau_(pp))0=D_{p} \frac{\partial^{2} p_{n}}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\delta p_{n}}{\tau_{p}} \Rightarrow \frac{d^{2} p_{n}}{d x^{2}} D \frac{\delta p_{n}}{\tau_{p p}}
  • Moreover, since the (n-type) doping is uniform, then
    此外，由于（n 型）掺杂是均匀的，因此
p n ( x ) = p n 0 + δ p n ( x ) ⇒ d 2 p n d x 2 = d 2 ( δ p ) d x 2 p n ( x ) = p n 0 + δ p n ( x ) ⇒ d 2 p n d x 2 = d 2 ( δ p ) d x 2 p_(n)(x)=p_(n0)+deltap_(n)(x)=>(d^(2)p_(n))/(dx^(2))=(d^(2)(delta p))/(dx^(2))p_{n}(x)=p_{n 0}+\delta p_{n}(x) \Rightarrow \frac{d^{2} p_{n}}{d x^{2}}=\frac{d^{2}(\delta p)}{d x^{2}}
and hence  因此
d 2 ( δ p n ) d x 2 = δ p n D p τ p = δ p n L p 2 d 2 δ p n d x 2 = δ p n D p τ p = δ p n L p 2 (d^(2)(deltap_(n)))/(dx^(2))=(deltap_(n))/(D_(p)tau_(p))=(deltap_(n))/(L_(p)^(2))\frac{d^{2}\left(\delta p_{n}\right)}{d x^{2}}=\frac{\delta p_{n}}{D_{p} \tau_{p}}=\frac{\delta p_{n}}{L_{p}^{2}}
  • This is a 2 nd 2 nd  2^("nd ")2^{\text {nd }} order ODE, with a general solution of the following form:
    这是一个 2 nd 2 nd  2^("nd ")2^{\text {nd }} 阶常微分方程，其通解形式如下：
δ p n ( x ) = C 1 exp ⁡ ( x L p ) + C 2 exp ⁡ ( − x L p ) δ p n ( x ) = C 1 exp ⁡ x L p + C 2 exp ⁡ − x L p deltap_(n)(x)=C_(1)exp((x)/(L_(p)))+C_(2)exp(-(x)/(L_(p)))\delta p_{n}(x)=C_{1} \exp \left(\frac{x}{L_{p}}\right)+C_{2} \exp \left(-\frac{x}{L_{p}}\right)
  • The parameter  参数
  • is the minority carrier diffusion length (for holes in the case of an n-type semiconductor).
    是少数载流子扩散长度（对于 n 型半导体中的空穴而言）。
  • This is the average distance travelled (or diffused) by minority carriers before they disappear naturally via recombination with the majority carriers.
    这是少数载流子在自然通过与多数载流子复合消失之前所能移动（或扩散）的平均距离。
  • Note that the diffusion length depends on both the diffusivity and the minority carrier lifetime:
    注意，扩散长度取决于扩散率和少数载流子寿命：
  • A higher diffusivity means that the carrier can diffuse a greater distance in a given time;
    较高的扩散率意味着载流子在给定时间内可以扩散更远的距离；
  • The minority carrier lifetime represents the average time before a carrier recombines - the longer this is, the further the carrier will travel before recombination.
    少数载流子寿命表示载流子复合前的平均时间——寿命越长，载流子在复合前能传播得越远。

Example  例子

The minority carrier lifetime in a p-type silicon sample is 10 ns. In this case, the minority carrier is the electron. Using the Einstein relation, we have,
在这种情况下，少数载流子是电子。利用爱因斯坦关系，我们有，
D n μ n = k T e ⇒ D n = 1500 cm 2 V − 1 s − 1 × 0.0259 V = 38.85 cm 2 s − 1 D n μ n = k T e ⇒ D n = 1500 cm 2 V − 1 s − 1 × 0.0259 V = 38.85 cm 2 s − 1 {:[(D_(n))/(mu_(n))=(kT)/(e)],[=>D_(n)=1500cm^(2)V^(-1)s^(-1)xx0.0259V=38.85cm^(2)s^(-1)]:}\begin{aligned} & \frac{D_{n}}{\mu_{n}}=\frac{k T}{e} \\ & \Rightarrow D_{n}=1500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \mathrm{~V}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1} \times 0.0259 \mathrm{~V}=38.85 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \mathrm{~s}^{-1} \end{aligned}
Hence the diffusion length is
因此扩散长度为
L n = D n τ n = 38.85 cm 2 s − 1 × 10 − 8 s = 6.23 × 10 − 4 cm = 6.23 μ m L n = D n τ n = 38.85 cm 2 s − 1 × 10 − 8 s = 6.23 × 10 − 4 cm = 6.23 μ m L_(n)=sqrt(D_(n)tau_(n))=sqrt(38.85cm^(2)s^(-1)xx10^(-8)s)=6.23 xx10^(-4)cm=6.23 mumL_{n}=\sqrt{D_{n} \tau_{n}}=\sqrt{38.85 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \mathrm{~s}^{-1} \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{~s}}=6.23 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~cm}=6.23 \mu \mathrm{~m}

-What is happening, physically?
-物理上发生了什么？
-If the boundary is far away (a >> L n L n L_(n)L_{n} ), excess carriers recombine over a length scale of a few L n L n L_(n)L_{n}.
-如果边界很远（a >> L n L n L_(n)L_{n} ），多余载流子将在几个 L n L n L_(n)L_{n} 的长度尺度上复合。
-Hence as the excess carrier diffuse, they recombine & disappear, and the diffusion flux decreases with distance viz.
-因此，当多余载流子扩散时，它们会复合并消失，扩散通量随距离减小，即。
F n = D n ( − d δ n d x ) where δ n = Δ n 1 exp ⁡ ( − x L n ) = − D n d d x ( Δ n 1 exp ⁡ ( − x L n ) ) = D n L n Δ n 1 exp ⁡ ( − x L n ) F n = D n − d δ n d x  where  δ n = Δ n 1 exp ⁡ − x L n = − D n d d x Δ n 1 exp ⁡ − x L n = D n L n Δ n 1 exp ⁡ − x L n {:[F_(n)=D_(n)(-(d delta n)/(dx))quad" where "quad delta n=Deltan_(1)exp(-(x)/(L_(n)))],[=-D_(n)(d)/(dx)(Deltan_(1)exp(-(x)/(L_(n))))],[=(D_(n))/(L_(n))Deltan_(1)exp(-(x)/(L_(n)))]:}\begin{aligned} F_{n} & =D_{n}\left(-\frac{d \delta n}{d x}\right) \quad \text { where } \quad \delta n=\Delta n_{1} \exp \left(-\frac{x}{L_{n}}\right) \\ & =-D_{n} \frac{d}{d x}\left(\Delta n_{1} \exp \left(-\frac{x}{L_{n}}\right)\right) \\ & =\frac{D_{n}}{L_{n}} \Delta n_{1} \exp \left(-\frac{x}{L_{n}}\right) \end{aligned}

Non-equilibrium Excess Carriers in Semiconductors -
半导体中的非平衡多余载流子 -

Continuity Equation  连续性方程
-If the distance to the boundary is much less than the diffusion length ( a ≪ L n a ≪ L n a≪L_(n)a \ll L_{n} ), then over this distance, few carriers recombine.
-如果到边界的距离远小于扩散长度（ a ≪ L n a ≪ L n a≪L_(n)a \ll L_{n} ），那么在这段距离内，载流子复合很少。
-Hence the diffusion flux is constant, which is why the concentration gradient is constant (straight line).
-因此扩散通量是恒定的，这就是浓度梯度保持恒定（直线）的原因。
F n = D n ( − d δ n d x ) where δ n = Δ n 1 ( a − x a ) = − D n d d x ( Δ n 1 ( a − x a ) ) = D n a Δ n 1 F n = D n − d δ n d x  where  δ n = Δ n 1 a − x a = − D n d d x Δ n 1 a − x a = D n a Δ n 1 {:[F_(n)=D_(n)(-(d delta n)/(dx))quad" where "quad delta n=Deltan_(1)((a-x)/(a))],[=-D_(n)(d)/(dx)(Deltan_(1)((a-x)/(a)))],[=(D_(n))/(a)Deltan_(1)]:}\begin{aligned} F_{n} & =D_{n}\left(-\frac{d \delta n}{d x}\right) \quad \text { where } \quad \delta n=\Delta n_{1}\left(\frac{a-x}{a}\right) \\ & =-D_{n} \frac{d}{d x}\left(\Delta n_{1}\left(\frac{a-x}{a}\right)\right) \\ & =\frac{D_{n}}{a} \Delta n_{1} \end{aligned}
An analogy (not perfect!)
一个类比（不完美！）
Sand lost, resulting in a lower sand-out flux compared to the sand-in flux.
砂子流失，导致砂子输出通量低于砂子输入通量。

2.S Equation Summary  2.S 方程总结

(a) Continuity equation for minority carriers
（a）少数载流子的连续性方程
∂ p n ( x , t ) ∂ t = − 1 e ∂ J p ∂ x + g p ′ − δ p n τ p : (holes in n-type semiconductor) ∂ n p ( x , t ) ∂ t = 1 e ∂ J n ∂ x + g n ′ − δ n p τ n : (electrons in p-type semiconductor) ∂ p n ( x , t ) ∂ t = − 1 e ∂ J p ∂ x + g p ′ − δ p n τ p      :  (holes in n-type semiconductor)  ∂ n p ( x , t ) ∂ t = 1 e ∂ J n ∂ x + g n ′ − δ n p τ n      :  (electrons in p-type semiconductor)  {:[(delp_(n)(x,t))/(del t)=-(1)/(e)(delJ_(p))/(del x)+g_(p)^(')-(deltap_(n))/(tau_(p)),:" (holes in n-type semiconductor) "],[(deln_(p)(x,t))/(del t)=(1)/(e)(delJ_(n))/(del x)+g_(n)^(')-(deltan_(p))/(tau_(n)),:" (electrons in p-type semiconductor) "]:}\begin{array}{ll} \frac{\partial p_{n}(x, t)}{\partial t}=-\frac{1}{e} \frac{\partial J_{p}}{\partial x}+g_{p}^{\prime}-\frac{\delta p_{n}}{\tau_{p}} & : \text { (holes in n-type semiconductor) } \\ \frac{\partial n_{p}(x, t)}{\partial t}=\frac{1}{e} \frac{\partial J_{n}}{\partial x}+g_{n}^{\prime}-\frac{\delta n_{p}}{\tau_{n}} & : \text { (electrons in p-type semiconductor) } \end{array}
The equations are valid for low-level injection conditions.
这些方程适用于低注入水平条件。
The current densities include both drift and diffusion components in general:
电流密度通常包括漂移和扩散两部分：
J p = e p μ p E − e D p ∂ p ∂ x : J n = e n μ n E + e D n ∂ n ∂ x J p = e p μ p E − e D p ∂ p ∂ x : J n = e n μ n E + e D n ∂ n ∂ x J_(p)=epmu_(p)E-eD_(p)(del p)/(del x):quadJ_(n)=enmu_(n)E+eD_(n)(del n)/(del x)J_{p}=e p \mu_{p} \mathrm{E}-e D_{p} \frac{\partial p}{\partial x}: \quad J_{n}=e n \mu_{n} \mathrm{E}+e D_{n} \frac{\partial n}{\partial x}
(b) Minority carrier diffusion length
（b）少数载流子扩散长度
L p = D p τ p : (holes in n-type semiconductor) L n = D n τ n : (electrons in p-type semiconductor) L p = D p τ p      :  (holes in n-type semiconductor)  L n = D n τ n      :  (electrons in p-type semiconductor)  {:[L_(p)=sqrt(D_(p)tau_(p)),:" (holes in n-type semiconductor) "],[L_(n)=sqrt(D_(n)tau_(n)),:" (electrons in p-type semiconductor) "]:}\begin{array}{ll} L_{p}=\sqrt{D_{p} \tau_{p}} & : \text { (holes in n-type semiconductor) } \\ L_{n}=\sqrt{D_{n} \tau_{n}} & : \text { (electrons in p-type semiconductor) } \end{array}
The diffusion length is the average distance travelled by minority carriers (in the absence of drift) before they disappear via recombination.
扩散长度是少数载流子（在无漂移的情况下）在通过复合消失之前平均移动的距离。
